config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = true

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.dynp]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "real-name"
provider = "dynp"
model = "gpt-4o"
enabled = false
aliases = ["dynp/ghost"]
name: m4_static_disabled_alias_dynamic_bypass
